name: Connoisseur
text: Whenever you recruit a blue member, +1 blue.

name: Critic
text: Whenever a rival recruits a blue member, +1 follower.

name: Doorman
text: Whenever a rival recruits more than once in a turn (swaps count), +1 blue.

name: Patroness
text: Whenever a shop member goes to the bottom of the pile, +1 follower.

name: Plus-One
text: On Recruit: recruit again this turn.

name: Regular
text: Whenever you buy followers, +1 blue.

name: Restocker
text: Once per game: send the whole shop to the bottom of the pile, then refill.

name: Shopaholic
text: You can always recruit twice.

name: Snob
text: Game end: +1 follower per blue member you have.

name: Trendsetter
text: Whenever you recruit a member, send 1 shop member to the bottom of the pile, then refill.

name: Window Dresser
text: On Recruit: send 3 shop members to the bottom of the pile, then refill.

name: Window Shopper
text: On Recruit: send 1 shop member to the bottom of the pile, gain 1 of its color. Round Start: send 1 shop member to the bottom of the pile, gain 1 of its color.

name: Benefactor
text: On Recruit: +3 silver, and +1 silver to a rival you choose. Round Start: +3 silver, and +1 silver to a rival you choose.

name: Debutante
text: Once per game: double your silver. Each rival +2 silver.

name: Grand Host
text: Double the silver you gain from Silver spaces.

name: Guest
text: Whenever a rival gives you something, +1 more of it.

name: Heir
text: On Recruit: +1 silver per member you have. Round III Start: +1 silver per member you have.

name: Majordomo
text: Whenever you take a Silver space, +2 silver.

name: Retinue
text: Worth 3 followers. On Recruit: each rival +1 silver.

name: Revelers
text: Counts as 3 members.

name: Patron Saint
text: Game end: +1 follower per 2 silver members, anyone’s.

name: Upstart
text: On Recruit: gain half the silver of the rival with the most, rounded up.
